title: terminal: update page_serial_min properly when erasing a page to avoid crash in search
body:
Fixes #11957

erasePage now updates page_serial_min when the first page is erased, and asserts that only front or back pages are erased since page_serial_min cannot represent serial gaps from middle erasure.

eraseRows can still technically destroy middle pages but no caller does that today. We'll have to rethink this eventually.
